forecastActuals.workingCapitalBasis: Arithmetic mean of five consecutive annual change-in-NWC/revenue ratios. Change in NWC = negative FMP cash-flow changeInWorkingCapital (includes other operating working capital); positive increases consume cash. Not a difference of only receivables, inventories and payables.

revenueProvenance.comparabilityBasis: The IAS18/IAS17 group covers the reviewed periods before 2018. FY2015's re-presented EPS is not an income-scope restatement: naga-2016-annual/page145 explicitly identifies the bonus element of a share placing, so it does not create a monetary-income TTM boundary; EPS remains non-additive. naga-2018-interim/pages45-47 adopts IFRS15 using the cumulative-effect method, expressly does not restate 2017, and changes EGM licence-fee recognition, requiring a separate IFRS15/IAS17 group for 2018. naga-2019-annual/pages140-142 documents modified-retrospective IFRS16 and changed lease/D&A/finance charges, so 2019-2020 share a different basis. From 2021 the separate gaming-tax deduction above reported GP is retained as a further presentation boundary; printed cost of sales is not inflated into a residual including that tax. FY2025 in naga-2025-annual/pages215,220,238 and the paired H12025/H12026 columns in naga-2026-interim/pages39,48 share this current group. Actual Russia-related impairment remains in operating results, not adjusted out or treated as a discontinued-scope restatement. Current TTM is supported for available additive income fields; missing standalone interest income remains null.
revenueProvenance.basis: Actual consolidated statutory revenue in US dollars. Retains genuine issuer gross profit and cost of sales. From 2021 a separate gaming-tax expense is presented above gross profit: this tax is not added to already reported revenue. Older gaming-tax and commission presentations are not mechanically restated.
revenueProvenance.operatingIncomeBasis: Rows marked reported use Profit from operations. Earlier derived rows sum the complete disclosed operating lines (gross profit plus other income less administrative and other operating expenses, and the separately displayed depreciation/amortisation in H12009/2010). No additional financing or equity-accounted line intervenes before pretax profit in those early statements. This presentation-based operating subtotal includes interest income within other income and is not a reported operating subtotal.
revenueProvenance.costOfRevenueBasis: The explicit issuer cost-of-sales line only. From 2021 the separately presented gaming tax also reduces gross profit; costOfRevenue is not an invented revenue-minus-GP residual and does not include that separately disclosed tax.
revenueProvenance.limitations: Real reported GP is retained, including FY2025 USD576,915 thousand on USD709,673 thousand revenue; operating profit is USD311,253 thousand and attributable net profit USD309,907 thousand. D&A explicitly sums own-asset/ROU depreciation/amortisation plus separately disclosed casino-licence amortisation (no double count, no EBITDA-minus-EBIT inference). Other operating impairments, including the 2024 Russia-related losses, remain in operating profit; this is not adjusted EBITDA. Early operating results are derived from complete operating lines and clearly labeled; later results use the reported operating subtotal. From 2021 GP subtracts both the printed cost-of-sales line and separately printed gaming tax; the machine costOfRevenue field intentionally preserves only printed cost of sales. Interim standalone accrued interest income after H12012 is not separately disclosed in the reviewed interim reports and remains null, not inherited from FMP or equated to cash interest received. Financing expense follows the reported finance-cost subtotal. Basic/diluted EPS are actual USD per share, not HKD-converted or multiplied by thousands. Early single-EPS disclosures do not justify inventing diluted EPS. FY2015 EPS follows the re-presented 2016 comparative. The two identically labeled EPS rows on the FY2017 statement are resolved by the explicit basic/diluted denominators in note12/page147. No balance-sheet/cash-flow audit certification.
